title: Steele Wheels Motor Museum Admission Ticket
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the world of classic and exotic cars. This unique venue showcases an impressive collection of vehicles, offering guests a glimpse into automotive history. Whether you're a car enthusiast or just looking for a memorable outing, Steele Wheels provides a customized experience perfect for events or simply exploring the exhibits. Complete with a cafe, theatre area, and arcade; ideal destination for anyone looking to discover their car story, making this a fantastic day out for everyone.
